# MLB.com
> The official site of Major League Baseball with live scores, schedules, stats, video, news, and streaming.

MLB.com provides league-wide coverage of Major League Baseball, including game results, standings, player and team statistics, transactions, injuries, prospect coverage, postseason events, and subscription streaming through MLB.TV.

## Core Coverage
- [MLB Home](https://www.mlb.com/): Main entry point for scores, schedules, standings, highlights, and featured stories.
- [News](https://www.mlb.com/news): League-wide baseball news, analysis, features, and breaking updates.
- [Scores](https://www.mlb.com/scores): Live and completed game scores with inning-by-inning results and game details.
- [Schedule](https://www.mlb.com/schedule): Full MLB game schedule with dates, matchups, and broadcast information.
- [Standings](https://www.mlb.com/standings): Division, league, and Wild Card standings across the season.
- [Stats](https://www.mlb.com/stats): League, team, and player statistical leaderboards and filters.

## Teams
- [Teams Directory](https://www.mlb.com/team): Directory of MLB clubs with links to each team site and roster coverage.
- [Arizona Diamondbacks](https://www.mlb.com/dbacks): Official team site with roster, schedule, news, and scores.
- [Atlanta Braves](https://www.mlb.com/braves): Official team site with roster, schedule, news, and scores.
- [Boston Red Sox](https://www.mlb.com/redsox): Official team site with roster, schedule, news, and scores.
- [Chicago Cubs](https://www.mlb.com/cubs): Official team site with roster, schedule, news, and scores.
- [Los Angeles Dodgers](https://www.mlb.com/dodgers): Official team site with roster, schedule, news, and scores.
- [New York Yankees](https://www.mlb.com/yankees): Official team site with roster, schedule, news, and scores.
- [St. Louis Cardinals](https://www.mlb.com/cardinals): Official team site with roster, schedule, news, and scores.

## Scores, Game Data, and Lineups
- [Starting Lineups](https://www.mlb.com/starting-lineups): Daily starting lineups for scheduled MLB games.
- [Gameday](https://www.mlb.com/gameday): Live game tracking with play-by-play, pitch data, and box scores.
- [Probable Pitchers](https://www.mlb.com/probable-pitchers): Scheduled starting pitchers for upcoming MLB games.
- [Postseason Schedule](https://www.mlb.com/postseason): Postseason bracket, schedule, scores, and series coverage.
- [All-Star Game](https://www.mlb.com/all-star): Official All-Star coverage, events, rosters, and news.
- [Spring Training](https://www.mlb.com/spring-training): Spring Training schedules, standings, and preseason coverage.

## Stats and Analytics
- [Player Stats](https://www.mlb.com/stats/player): Player batting, pitching, and fielding leaderboards.
- [Team Stats](https://www.mlb.com/stats/team): Team-level offensive, pitching, and defensive statistics.
- [Statcast](https://www.mlb.com/statcast): Advanced tracking data, metrics, leaderboards, and explanatory content.
- [Statcast Search](https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/statcast_search): Searchable Statcast event data across players, pitches, and batted balls.
- [Leaderboard Index](https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/leaderboard): Baseball Savant leaderboards for advanced performance metrics.
- [Awards](https://www.mlb.com/awards): Official MLB awards coverage, winners, finalists, and historical results.

## Players, Rosters, and Transactions
- [Player Search](https://www.mlb.com/player): Player directory and profile lookup across MLB.
- [Transactions](https://www.mlb.com/transactions): Official transaction log for roster moves, signings, and assignments.
- [Injury Report](https://www.mlb.com/injury-report): Current player injury statuses, updates, and expected returns.
- [Roster Resource](https://www.mlb.com/roster-resource): Team roster construction and depth chart information.
- [Draft](https://www.mlb.com/draft): MLB Draft coverage, picks, rankings, and prospect news.
- [Free Agent Tracker](https://www.mlb.com/free-agent-tracker): Free agent signings, rumors context, and offseason movement tracking.

## Prospects and Minor Leagues
- [MLB Pipeline](https://www.mlb.com/pipeline): Prospect rankings, scouting reports, mock drafts, and farm system coverage.
- [Top 100 Prospects](https://www.mlb.com/prospects/top100/): MLB Pipeline’s Top 100 prospect rankings and player reports.
- [Prospect Watch](https://www.mlb.com/prospects/stats/): Minor league prospect statistics and performance tracking.
- [MiLB Home](https://www.mlb.com/milb): Minor League Baseball news, scores, schedules, and affiliate coverage.
- [Arizona Fall League](https://www.mlb.com/arizona-fall-league): Official Arizona Fall League schedule, rosters, and prospect coverage.

## Video, Audio, and Streaming
- [Video](https://www.mlb.com/video): Highlights, interviews, recaps, and featured baseball video clips.
- [Film Room](https://www.mlb.com/video/search): Searchable video archive for plays, players, and game moments.
- [MLB.TV](https://www.mlb.com/live-stream-games): Streaming hub for live and on-demand MLB game viewing.
- [MLB.TV Subscription](https://www.mlb.com/live-stream-games/subscribe): Subscription plans and package details for MLB streaming.
- [Audio](https://www.mlb.com/audio): Audio content including game broadcasts and featured clips.
- [Podcasts](https://www.mlb.com/fans/podcasts): Official MLB podcast directory and show pages.

## Events and International
- [Postseason](https://www.mlb.com/postseason): Official postseason hub with bracket, schedule, and series coverage.
- [World Baseball Classic](https://www.mlb.com/world-baseball-classic): International tournament coverage, rosters, schedule, and results.
- [Field of Dreams](https://www.mlb.com/field-of-dreams): Coverage of the MLB Field of Dreams event and related stories.
- [Little League Classic](https://www.mlb.com/little-league-classic): Event coverage, schedules, and game information.
- [London Series](https://www.mlb.com/london-series): Official MLB London Series event coverage and updates.

## Fans and Tickets
- [Tickets](https://www.mlb.com/tickets): League ticket hub with links to team ticketing and event sales.
- [Ballpark](https://www.mlb.com/ballpark): Ballpark guides, venue information, and fan experience resources.
- [Fan Forums](https://www.mlb.com/fans): Fan-focused content, activities, and engagement resources.
- [MLB Shop](https://www.mlbshop.com/): Official merchandise store for jerseys, apparel, and collectibles.
- [Apps](https://www.mlb.com/apps): Official MLB apps for scores, streaming, and mobile access.

## History and Reference
- [Official Information](https://www.mlb.com/official-information): Rules, executives, umpires, and league reference information.
- [Postseason History](https://www.mlb.com/postseason/history): Historical postseason results, champions, and year-by-year recaps.
- [Hall of Fame](https://www.mlb.com/hall-of-fame): Hall of Fame coverage, inductees, and related baseball history.
- [Record Book](https://www.mlb.com/stats): Statistical records and leaderboards across MLB history.
- [Glossary](https://www.mlb.com/glossary): Definitions for baseball terms, stats, and advanced metrics.
